# Tejas Mahajan

> PhD Student in Computer Science at the University of Central Florida (UCF Computational Biology Lab, Dr. Wei Zhang). Graduate Research Assistant and Teaching Assistant. Work in AI/ML, single-cell multi-omics, AI security, quantitative methods, and systems / computer architecture.

## Education
- **University of Central Florida (Orlando, FL)**: Ph.D. in Computer Science (2025 – 2031), Computational Biology Lab (Dr. Wei Zhang).
- B.E. in Computer Science & Communications Engineering, Waseda University (2021 – 2025).

## Selected Manuscripts and Research Software
These items also appear on Google Scholar. They are research software or manuscripts, not peer-reviewed journal articles, unless a venue is named.
- **FairDRAM**: QoS-Aware Memory Scheduling for CPU–AI Co-Execution (research software, 2026).
- **SyntheticShield**: Auditing Memorization and Membership Leakage in Synthetic Data Generators (research software, 2026).
- **ModelCardSec**: Automated Privacy and Security Risk Profiling for Machine Learning Models (research software, 2026).
- **PromptLeakDetector**: Runtime Detection of System Prompt and Context Leakage in LLM Applications (research software, 2026).
- **RAGGuard**: A Context-Aware Privacy Firewall for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (research software, 2026).
- **Differential Expression Benchmark**: Comparative differential expression analysis: PyDESeq2 vs. InMoose edgeR for bulk RNA-seq in asthma airway smooth muscle (ResearchGate preprint, 2025).

## Key Software Projects
- **Computational Biology & Clinical AI**: HelixMatch (clinical trial RAG matcher), AURA Clinical (sepsis/deterioration RPM predictor), Aegis (CMS claims fraud detector), Causal Dynamic GRN, Single-Cell Foundation Embedding Transfer, Multi-Omics Cancer Stratification.
- **Quantitative Finance**: Tejas Trading (Kalshi-style prediction market), Rust → Quant (interactive Rust quant finance course), TradeSim (Black–Scholes options/equities simulator), Orderbook & Arbitrage Simulator, News Sentiment Stock Predictor, Stock Scraper, Portfolio Diversity Calculator, Northstar, FICO Credit Score Simulator, CardFind.
- **AI Security & Systems**: SyntheticShield, RAGGuard, PromptLeakDetector, ModelCardSec, FairDRAM, 4-Bit Ripple-Carry Adder Visualizer, DFS/BFS/A* Pathfinding Simulator, Sorting Visualizer.
